criteria.criterion: Access the UniProtKB entry page for accession P04637 (or determine it is inaccessible)
criteria.description: Attempt to open UniProtKB accession P04637 (e.g., the provided /uniprotkb/P04637/entry page). Full credit if the agent clearly indicates UniProt is inaccessible (site down, blocked, captcha, network error) and therefore cannot verify the requested fields. Partial credit if the agent accesses UniProt but it is unclear whether the content viewed corresponds to P04637.

criteria.criterion: Stopping condition met (all six fields reported, then stop)
criteria.description: After obtaining data from P04637, the agent outputs exactly the six requested fields (entry name, recommended protein name, primary gene name, organism, canonical sequence length, reviewed status) and stops. Partial credit if all six are provided but extra non-requested information is included. If UniProt is inaccessible and the agent cannot retrieve the fields but clearly reports the access limitation, award partial credit rather than zero.
